themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can perform research tasks independently or collaboratively, including data gathering, analysis, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, acting as collaborators in the development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about AI-powered platforms and software designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the skills required in the workforce, including potential job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content focusing on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, providing key insights and overviews.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is being used to inform and enhance the design process, from generating initial concepts to refining user interfaces.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions about AI's role in automating or augmenting usability testing processes, including identifying issues and providing feedback.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Content related to AI applications in creating, distributing, analyzing, and optimizing surveys for user research and market insights.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's application in the recruitment process, including analyzing job markets, candidate screening, and hiring trends.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Discussions on using AI to analyze and understand user sentiment from various sources, such as reviews, social media, and feedback forms.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
